# Application intake check

Lead with BP-2024-3847, Johnson Residence (123 Oak Lane), contractor Premier Builders LLC (License #BLD-48291), scope 400 sq ft master bedroom + bathroom addition. Show the five required items (site plan, structural drawings, property survey, proof of insurance complete; HOA approval missing, required for this zone), the $847 fee on the $68K project value, and the recommendation: on hold until the HOA approval letter arrives. Never claim the application was accepted, rejected, or put on hold in a live system.
